scope: Focused correctness qualification of base-deadline selection before the first published extension reservation, together with its audit maintenance. This does not clear populated-state or teardown readiness.
changes: One monotonic atomic phase orders observed base expiry against first reservation publication. An expiry winner seals grants; a publication winner uses the existing state-based path.
The state-based phase is sticky after any publication or monitor fallback. Empty holds do not reactivate the base-only path.
The fixed base deadline is copied from the same original start and timeout used to create State. Its unpublished selector does not acquire the state mutex.

Periodic audit work uses the existing Job monitor and existing one-second backstop interval. The monitor tries State without waiting; eligible notices are consumed and enqueued while State remains held.
Rate-accounting and refusal paths service the same due work under an already-owned State lock. Four accounting entry points are covered, and time is sampled again after due audit work.
Dequeued native exit notifications are forwarded before audit maintenance. Unexpected monitor errors can switch the unpublished phase to the legacy path without reopening a sealed run.
The existing child and owner wait, exact reservation rollback, reply authorization and release acknowledgment behavior remain in use.

qualification.G28: Both unchanged timeout and natural-exit branches passed their expected exits, fixture markers and existing child-gone predicates.
qualification.clippy: Exited zero; warnings remain. No warning-free or warning-anchor equivalence claim.

limits: The CAS orders the supervisor's observed expiry against reservation publication; it is not proof of an absolute wall-clock publication cutoff.
The one-second audit schedule uses relative IOCP waits. Notice scheduling and timestamps can differ across suspend and concurrent activity; the existing enforcement clock is unchanged.
Controlled regression cases do not constitute an exhaustive real native IOCP flood, suspend/resume or concurrency proof.
Worker and monitor joins do not establish a hard operating-system completion bound.
This used debug test artifacts, not a fresh stock release or a performance comparison.
Preselection locking after publication or monitor fallback, prekill descendant discovery and general settlement remain unresolved.
The repaired reference remains ineligible. Speed acceptance, the comprehensive benchmark and the final public package remain unfinished.
No A013 retry, row reuse, ranking or acceptance-rule change occurred.
